svg.title: If not, select violations with C = en. Put pn,a = −log Ra(wn), Sn = P a pn,a and Tn = n + Sn. On an ultrafilter refining the sequence tail, compactness of finitely many coordinates gives pn,a/Tn →sa and n/Tn →k, with k + P a sa = 1. The path hypothesis gives upper rate c for F, whereas the violating comparison quantity enq(wn) Q a Ra(wn)−ε has exact rate c+k+ε P a sa > c; the increment is positive because k and all sa are nonnegative and their sum is one. A quantity of strictly larger exact rate eventually exceeds one of smaller upper rate, contradicting every chosen violation. The added n covers radii bounded away from zero. All bills here are generated by constants, positive
